description: This file defines a test implementation of a Reminder Grain class for Orleans, including methods to check, add, and remove reminders, as well as handling received reminders.

classes.name: ReminderTestGrain
classes.description: A test implementation of an Orleans Grain that manages reminders, implementing IReminderTestGrain and IRemindable interfaces.

methods.name: IsReminderExists
methods.description: Checks if a reminder with the specified name exists.

methods.name: AddReminder
methods.description: Adds or updates a reminder with a default interval of one day.

methods.name: RemoveReminder
methods.description: Removes a reminder with the specified name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Handles incoming reminders; currently not supported and throws exception.
